series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Aries came to the party at 6:58.
caption:
Aries came to the party at 6:58, set up every chair and moved the couch.
Then it started the dance floor alone, so nobody else had to go first.
Send this to the Aries who always shows up early.
